test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 28 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In 2024, which program organised youth exchange visits across states, focusing on the '5 Ps'; namely Paryatan (Tourism), Parampara (Traditions), Pragati (Development), Paraspar Sampark (People-to-people connect) and Prodyogiki (Technology)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yuva Sangam**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Yuva Sangam program organized **youth exchange visits across states in 2024, **focusing on the '5 Ps'**.
 
• **The 5 Ps are: **
 
 
• Paryatan: Tourism
 
• Parampara: Traditions
 
• Pragati: Development
 
• Paraspar Sampark: People-to-people connect
 
• Prodyogiki: Technology
 
 
 
• Yuva Sangam** is a program by the Government of India** that aims to strengthen connections between people, especially among young people. 
 
• The program involves e**xposure tours for students and other young people from one state to another. **
 
• The program is part of the Centre's “**Ek Bharat Shreshth Bharat” vision, **which aims to promote cultural unity and collaboration among India's youth. 
 
• The program provides a platform for young people to meet, interact, and learn from each other. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Youth Exchange**

 
 
• **​**The **National Youth Exchange Program** is an initiative aimed at fostering cultural understanding, unity, and national integration among the youth of India.
 
• It is typically organized by the **Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan (NYKS)** under the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.**
 
• **Benefits**:
 
 
• Builds a sense of **unity in diversity** among the youth.
 
• Encourages **understanding and appreciation** of India’s cultural richness.
 
• Strengthens **leadership skills** and enhances **teamwork**.
 
• Facilitates **networking** among participants from different parts of the country.
 
 
 
 
 
• **India Unites****​**
 
 
• The phrase “India Unites” often symbolizes the idea of **national integration** and **unity in diversity**, which aligns with India’s ethos of coexisting harmoniously despite its linguistic, religious, and cultural diversity.
 
• This concept is reflected in initiatives such as:
 
• **National Integration Day (November 19):** Celebrated to promote unity.
 
• **Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat Program:** A Government of India initiative to enhance cultural exchanges between states and UTs.
